chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Join Kids Heart Family

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Hello Boys! What's going on over here?

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We have a match against the teams from the other neighbourhood

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: but we can't agree upon anything.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Not even on who will be the captain and what kind of a game we will play.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Oh! That's bad!

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: You need to be a bundle of sticks boys and not single sticks.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: What do you mean?

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: You'll know in just a few minutes.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Once upon a time an old farmer lived with his three sons.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: They were lucky to have a good crop every year and grew richer every year.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But they did not have any respect in the village because the sons kept fighting amongst themselves.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: One day the farmer called his sons.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: My sons, I am now growing old and it is time for me to retire.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But before I do so, I have a competition set for you all.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The winner will get a big reward from me.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: What do we need to do father?

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Here are three bundles of sticks.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Each bundle has ten sticks in it.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The one who breaks each stick the fastest will be the winner.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: It was an easy task and the sons broke each stick into two quickly.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: As soon as they had done it, they started fighting again.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: I won father.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: How can you win when I broke all the sticks first?

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: I win.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: None of you broke the sticks as fast as I did.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: So I am the winner.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Wait, the competition isn't over yet.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: I still have one more task for you.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The farmer now handed over another bundle of ten sticks each to each son.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Now I want you to break the entire bundle of sticks into two.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Remember, you have to break the whole bundle at one go.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Don't pull out individual sticks.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The sons tried hard.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But they could not break their bundles.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Father, it is not possible to break the bundle.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Individual sticks can be broken.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes, the bundle is very very strong.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Exactly.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: You three are also like the sticks.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: As long as you stay united like the bundle, nobody can break you.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But if you keep fighting amongst yourselves, you are like the individual sticks.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Easy to break.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The three sons understood the valuable lesson their father had taught them.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: And never fought again.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We have also been behaving like the three sons, Tia.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Isn't it?

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We've been fighting amongst ourselves.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Yes, and if we continue like this, the other team will easily defeat us.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We will not fight anymore.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We will find a way to play together like a real team.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: That's a good decision boys.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: All the best.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Thanks Tia.
